Name: Pelatiah
Summary: Pelatiah, son of Benaiah, was one of the twenty-five princes at the east gate of the temple; as Ezekiel prophesied against them in vision, Pelatiah fell down dead, and Ezekiel cried out at the judgment.
KeyStory: While Ezekiel prophesied against the princes at the east gate, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died, and Ezekiel fell on his face and cried out to the Lord.
LifeLesson: Judgment can fall in the very moment the word is spoken — the prophecy is not a warning about someday, but about now.
